headline: Former MP of Pakistan now sells ice cream in Haryana: Fled after minority persecution in Bhutto’s era; says he will be first to pick up arms if war breaks out

detail.heading: Former Pakistani MP Turns Ice Cream Vendor in Haryana
detail.leadingParagraph: A former Member of Parliament from Pakistan, who fled the country during the Bhutto era due to minority persecution, has now settled in Haryana and is earning a living by selling ice cream. He shared his journey and his readiness to defend his new home if tensions escalate.
paragraphs: The former MP, who wishes to remain anonymous, spoke about the challenges he faced after leaving Pakistan. 'I had to start from scratch, but I found peace here,' he said.
Despite his humble occupation, he remains vigilant about the geopolitical situation. 'If war breaks out, I will be the first to pick up arms to protect this land,' he added.

headline: AI Breakthrough: New Model Can Predict Weather Patterns with 99% Accuracy

detail.heading: AI Model Achieves 99% Accuracy in Weather Prediction
detail.leadingParagraph: A groundbreaking AI model developed by researchers can now predict weather patterns with an unprecedented 99% accuracy, potentially revolutionizing how we prepare for natural disasters.
paragraphs: The model uses advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze historical weather data and real-time inputs from satellites.
Experts believe this technology could save lives by providing early warnings for hurricanes, floods, and other extreme weather events.
